claims.claim: YOLOv3 uses Darknet-53 with residual connections and multiscale features
claims.notes: Depth alone does not specify detection neck/head.

claims.claim: CSPNet splits stage feature flow to reduce redundant computation
claims.notes: Specific ratios and branches vary by block.

claims.claim: RepVGG training multi-branch linear blocks can merge to a single deployed 3x3 conv after BN folding
claims.notes: Requires matched spatial settings and linear branch addition.
